2. Reason: The Planner in Step 11 contains a significant factual error by claiming Vivien Leigh was married to Peter Finch. In reality, Vivien Leigh was married to Herbert Leigh Holman (1932–1933) and Laurence Olivier (1940–1960). She was never married to Peter Finch; Peter Finch was married to his third wife, Joan Plowright (after Laurence Olivier divorced Vivien Leigh and remarried Joan), and later to others, but not to Vivien Leigh. This hallucination would lead to an incorrect final answer. Additionally, the instruction to check for a marriage to Peter Finch on Wikipedia is based on this false premise.
